answer: A mechanism that actually bites: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because raven only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, karst is enforced in the ledger: The cost curve is the deterrent: honest agents pay it once, farms pay it per identity. Any violet approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
